summary: Full validation of Djeph marketplace (backend + frontend). 18/18 pytest cases passed. Frontend end-to-end flows all working: landing hero, 16 seeded service cards, search filter, service-card => contact preset & scroll, contact form submission (POST /api/requests => 200, WhatsApp popup URL built, success toast, form reset), admin login (wrong pwd rejected, correct accepted), category CRUD via modal (add + delete verified), and request status change + delete.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).
ADMIN_PASSWORD is plain text and returned as token; acceptable for a simple shared-password admin panel per product decision, but should be flagged if security requirements grow.
No rate limiting / captcha on public POST /api/requests - could be abused for spam; consider basic throttling.
Frontend Landing uses two useEffect API calls without loading/error UI states - low priority since fallbacks handle empty arrays.

Startup seed logs via `logger` before logger is defined (logger initialised on line 244 but referenced at line 230). Currently works because seed_data runs after module import but is a latent risk if seed logs during import.
seed_data_creation: Test artifacts (TEST_ prefixed categories and requests) were created and cleaned up during automated test runs. One residual seed 'Test User / Fuite deau' request remained (created by earlier manual smoke, not by this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass. Frontend flows validated via Playwright: landing (search, service-card preset+scroll), contact submission with WhatsApp popup and toast, admin login/wrong-pwd, category add/delete modal, request status update & delete. Backend endpoints all return correct status codes; all auth guards enforced; ObjectId excluded from responses. Reuse backend_test.py for regression.
